name: WinterX
description:
WinterX is WeirdMM's fan-made jailbreak companion for Spring. Use it with the local Ruby bridge and a compatible WinterX engine to start the patched launcher and access Ruby, the package manager for supported tweaks.

Currently supports Spring 0.8.1 on Mac.APK only. A computer running the bridge and a locally built WinterX engine are required; this app does not jailbreak Spring on its own. Windows/Linux bridge and rooted Android/emulator support are in development.

Experimental: back up your Spring data before use. WinterX is not an iOS jailbreak and is not affiliated with Spring or Apple.

Source code, setup guide and updates:
https://github.com/UltraFEmotes/WinterX
whatsNew: Shows only supported Spring 0.8.1, removes the preview selector and updates the app description and setup link.
